concerns.text: T005's baseline_results.csv columns are 'task_id, accuracy, nodes_visited, inference_time_seconds, token_count (plus status)' — the contract requires 'strategy' and 'latency_ms', forbids 'token_count' (additionalProperties: false), and uses latency_ms not inference_time_seconds. T005's deliverable cannot satisfy the contract it must conform to; T010's schema validation will deterministically fail. Align T005's columns with the contract (or amend the contract explicitly).

T012's validate_intermediate_artifacts() asserts 'triples_raw.jsonl' exists, but no task T001–T011 produces a triples_raw.jsonl and it appears in no plan section or contract. The pipeline will abort on a permanently missing artifact — a dropped/broken dependency constraint.

T001 says 'Compute and log the SHA-256 ... (do not write to state/)'. Constitution Principle III requires the checksum recorded under data/ (and the state artifact_hashes map); the plan (Phase 1.1) says store in state/. T001 actively forbids durable checksum recording — a constitution violation introduced by the task.

T002's exclusion rule 'flag tasks below the coherence threshold as invalid_graph and exclude them from strategy runs' narrows FR-002 ('traverses the entire relevant subgraph for each query') and US-1's 'every task has a recorded accuracy' without spec-level authorization. The plan mandates it, but the spec never sanctions dropping tasks; either record invalid_graph rows in results (status enum already includes invalid_graph) or amend the spec to authorize exclusion.
T006 sweeps thresholds '0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8' while the plan lists '0.6, 0.7, 0.8'. The sweep bounds are pinned nowhere authoritative; pick one source of truth and reconcile.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002/T004 vs plan.md Project Structure / data-model.md
concerns.text: Plan and data-model place noisy graphs at data/processed/noisy_graphs.json and raw data at data/raw/locomo.csv; T002/T004 use data/processed/graphs/graph_noise_42.json and T001 produces data/raw/locomo.jsonl. Path disagreement across artifacts threatens the reproducible data-flow contract — reconcile to one canonical set of paths.

Plan mandates timeout verification in tests/integration/test_timeout_handling.py; T004 cites test_timeout_handler.py and test_hard_timeout.py instead. The plan-mandated test is orphaned — either rename in the plan or add the plan-named test.

Principle VI requires Lazy/Greedy to 'demonstrate a measurable reduction in nodes visited (targeting 40-50%)' vs Full baseline. No task or verification step compares the measured node reduction against that target; SC-001 only reports the percentage. Add an explicit check (or document the target as aspirational in the spec).
